describe: Valley and Ridge: 12 beds, dipping 0.43° to the SE; tight folds every 2.0 km, 1442 m high, plunging along their axes.
notes: A N-S thrust fault stacks the beds 867 m: its crushed zone wears into a gully and leaks groundwater. Seismic: repeated reflectors.
A N-S thrust fault stacks the beds 457 m: its crushed zone wears into a gully and leaks groundwater. Seismic: repeated reflectors.
6 sinkhole seeds in the limestone: they dissolve into closed hollows, and streams on bare limestone sink into the ground and come out as cave springs. Microgravity lows over voids.
